title: I Took the Climbing-Wall Reset Log Through Three Open Nights After They Skipped the Holds

parts.text: They skipped the Tuesday reset and posted a guest note on the wall log. I was thirty-four, route volunteer, holding a spin that still listed one color. At 7:12 p.m. the note opened the set closet and, I found, the hardware. Temporary, the setter said. I photographed the log, both bins, the time. Then a bag I did not recognize left with the same color toward the kids' wall. I did not argue the joke. I argued the spin. I have learned the difference between a route and a line item.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: An unrecognized bag just left with our color toward the kids' wall.

social.video_title: They posted a guest note on the reset log — Part 1/3
social.description: Reset skipped, a guest note, a bag toward kids' holds. Would you have followed the spin?

parts.text: I followed with the stills. The kids' wall took the same color. The person palmed a set that was not a route I could see from the camera cone. I was still thirty-four, still volunteered, suddenly the only witness with a timestamp. I messaged the desk the log still and stayed in the cone. The person looked at the cone, then at the last bin on the hardware. I added the second still before anyone could call it a vibe. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: They are at the hardware bin; the desk now has the still.

social.video_title: The same color walked to the kids' wall — Part 2/3
social.description: A palmed set, a camera cone, hardware next. The desk has the still. Do you stay in the cone?

parts.text: The desk locked the hardware from the office. The person left the bag and the note on a sticky. Morning recoded all three bins. The setter who called it temporary lost the closet privilege. I keep a spin that lists one color. Walls print routes now, not bags. The gym at 7:12 sounds like a gym, which is to say chalk and nobody's guest note. I go back to being a person with a receipt. The second photo is for the person who will say they never saw the first.

social.video_title: Morning recoded all three bins — Part 3/3
social.description: Sticky note, a lost privilege, walls that print routes. Was temporary ever three bins?
